# Be'er HaGolah on Shulchan Arukh, Even HaEzer

באר הגולה על שולחן ערוך אבן העזר

Link: [https://torahapp.org/share/book/Be%27er%20HaGolah%20on%20Shulchan%20Arukh%2C%20Even%20HaEzer](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Be%27er%20HaGolah%20on%20Shulchan%20Arukh%2C%20Even%20HaEzer)

ספר ההלכה המקובל והמרכזי ביותר בעולם היהודי. נכתב במאה ה-16.

17th-centrury reference work by Rabbi Moshe Rivkes citing sources for the Shulchan Arukh law's in earlier rabbinic literature.

Sections: Seif

Location: Halakhah/Shulchan Arukh/Commentary/Be'er HaGolah
